newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt says economic summit will be held on time.
newsitem.headline: Egypt says economic summit will be held on time.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak said on Thursday he was determined that a Middle East economic conference Egypt was hosting would take place on time.

Presidential advisor Osama el-Baz had said that Egypt might postpone until next spring the Cairo conference, scheduled for November 12 to 14, if negotiations between Israel and the Palestinians do not make enough progress soon.
"We are determined that the conference be held on time but Israel and the United States must take action so that it does not fail," Mubarak told reporters after a cabinet meeting.
Earlier this month, Mubarak said that several countries would not attend the conference with Israel present while the Middle East peace process was deadlocked.
The summit's main purpose will be to integrate Israel into the economy of the region.
